ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Wardens
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Guard, Warden, and the specialties Confessor, Overseer and Containment Keeper. Experience comes from the game's own warden work, conversion, slave oversight and containment work; specialty bonuses (conversion power, suppression power, study efficiency) apply only to a qualified pawn assigned to that exact specialty. Confessor and Overseer need Ideology and the Containment Keeper needs Anomaly: without them those specialties simply have no work. First slice only: the career, its events and its bonuses. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
